name: TelemetryDeck
description: TelemetryDeck is an app-analytics service for privacy-focused signal, usage, insight, and time-series analysis.
agentUseSummary: Connect one user-owned Personal Access Token, organization namespace, and selected app ID. Relay exposes account-health, bounded TQL-query, and saved-insight wrappers; signal ingestion, raw scan export, app and organization administration, unbounded or cross-app queries, scheduled polling, and raw beta MCP access remain blocked.

credentialRequirements.name: telemetrydeck_personal_access_token
credentialRequirements.label: Personal Access Token
credentialRequirements.helpText: Generate a dedicated TelemetryDeck PAT with an appropriate expiry. Relay stores only a secret-store reference.

credentialRequirements.name: telemetrydeck_namespace
credentialRequirements.label: Organization namespace
credentialRequirements.helpText: Enter the non-secret organization namespace/data source that scopes Relay reads.

credentialRequirements.name: telemetrydeck_app_id
credentialRequirements.label: TelemetryDeck app ID
credentialRequirements.helpText: Enter the exact non-secret app ID used by every bounded Relay analytics wrapper.

credentialRequirements.name: telemetrydeck_app_display_name
credentialRequirements.label: App display name
credentialRequirements.helpText: Optional non-secret display label for the selected app.

credentialRequirements.name: telemetrydeck_default_insight_id
credentialRequirements.label: Default insight ID
credentialRequirements.helpText: Optional non-secret saved-insight ID used when an action does not provide one.

capabilities.label: Account and organization health
capabilities.description: Read bounded user and organization identity for connection validation.

capabilities.label: Bounded TQL query
capabilities.description: Run an approval-gated read-only TQL query for the selected app within Relay's row and lookback limits.

capabilities.label: Saved insight
capabilities.description: Read one saved insight and a bounded result preview for the selected app.

allowed.label: Read user info
allowed.description: Read bounded user and organization identity for connection-health context.

allowed.label: Read saved insight
allowed.description: Retrieve and execute one saved insight for the selected app with bounded result rows.

approvalRequired.label: Run bounded TQL query
approvalRequired.description: Run a reviewed read-only TQL query for the selected app with at most 100 rows and 90 days of lookback.

blocked.label: Ingest signal
blocked.description: Sending, backfilling, or changing analytics signals is blocked.

blocked.label: Export raw scan data
blocked.description: Broad or raw scan export outside the current task context is blocked.

blocked.label: Administer app
blocked.description: App creation, deletion, settings, and instrumentation changes are blocked.

blocked.label: Administer organization
blocked.description: Organization, member, billing, access, and token administration is blocked.

blocked.label: Run unbounded query
blocked.description: Unbounded, cross-app, raw SQL-like, and unconstrained TQL queries are blocked.

blocked.label: Configure scheduled polling
blocked.description: Scheduled polling and background synchronization are blocked.

blocked.label: Use beta MCP surface
blocked.description: Raw provider and beta MCP tools are not exposed to agents.

approvalProfiles.label: Read only
approvalProfiles.description: Account and saved-insight reads run automatically; bounded TQL requires approval and all mutation, export, admin, polling, and raw surfaces remain blocked.

approvalProfiles.label: Dangerously skip permissions
approvalProfiles.description: The three read wrappers run without per-call approval while app binding, query shape, row, lookback, redaction, timeout, provider-authority, and audit guards remain enforced.

runtimeSupport.description: Relay mounts three bounded TelemetryDeck read wrappers and injects the PAT and app binding from encrypted connection storage.

providerSetup.nextAction: The customer generates a dedicated PAT, records it once, selects the organization namespace and exact app ID, and revokes or replaces the PAT in TelemetryDeck when required.

evidence.supports: TelemetryDeck documents paid-plan PAT creation, one-time display, expiry, revocation, Bearer authentication, the user-info endpoint, and that a PAT inherits the user's organization access.
TelemetryDeck documents PAT-authenticated execution of JSON-based TQL against the query endpoint.
TelemetryDeck documents retrieving the TQL query behind a saved insight and supplying an explicit relative interval before execution.
TelemetryDeck documents TQL query types and required query structure; Relay accepts only a bounded read-only subset.
